_comment: Tailwind CSS 4 + Lightning CSS does the real CSS validation at build time. VS Code's built-in CSS language server cannot parse modern syntax we rely on (Tailwind at-rules like @theme/@utility, and CSS Values Level 5 typed attr() — e.g. `attr(data-pct type(<percentage>))` — used for CSP-safe data-attribute theming), so it reports false-positive parse errors. Disable the built-in validators; lint via the build.
